title: Compare classifiers with and without PCA
description: You inspect training-only preprocessing and compare recorded evaluation metrics.

steps.description: You split the data with stratification and fit the scaler on training rows. Test rows use that fitted scaler's transform.
You optionally fit two-component PCA on the scaled training rows and transform test rows with it. Both branches fit the same one-versus-rest linear regression classifier.
You evaluate training and test predictions separately. The report includes macro averages across classes and weighted averages that account for class support.

steps.question: Does the recorded PCA version improve every test metric?
steps.answer: Test macro F1 rises from 0.7432 to 0.7939, while macro ROC AUC falls from 0.8923 to 0.8862. The metrics change in different directions.

steps.description: You display train and test confusion matrices for each branch and print both reports. Each comparison uses the same initial train-test split.
